responsibility: Provides the top-level LRA driver, global iteration logic, and shared utilities for the Local Register Allocator. It coordinates the repeated sequence of constraint solving, elimination updates, inheritance/split handling, live-range construction, pseudo assignment, coalescing, rematerialization, and spilling until all RTL constraints are satisfied, then performs final devirtualization and cleanup. It is the orchestration layer that ties together the specialized LRA subpasses and maintains their shared pass-wide state.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file contains the actual LRA allocator driver, iteration loop, and shared implementation utilities that execute constraint solving, assignment, spilling, and final cleanup. The companion header gcc/lra.h is only the small external interface declaring entry points and lightweight queries for non-LRA code.
